connection_type: I have direct personal experience (as an immigrant, refugee, religious minority, or member of a marginalised group)
disclosure_text: As a person of colour, it's always been evident to me that I'm different from others in my community. Sometimes it's hard to feel a sense of belonging though it's getting better somewhat.
micronarrative:
The city buzzes with a palpable tension, a heated engagement that seems to permeate every corner. I understand the desire to help undocumented migrants, but I also see the need to support our own community. The homeless population in my city is vast, and it's hard to navigate the complex emotions and needs of both groups. I feel torn, understanding the struggles of undocumented migrants while also feeling a deep empathy for those who are already part of our community.

I decided to volunteer at a homeless shelter and a refugee center, hoping to make a difference. Communication can be a challenge, especially when languages differ. Simple terms often help, and using hand gestures can bridge the gap. Google Translate has become my trusty ally, helping me navigate the different languages and ensuring that I can understand and be understood. Each time I use it, I feel a sense of connection and a small victory in bridging these divides.

annotations.tweet_text: Our hospitals can't keep up. At some point we have to ask who this country is actually for.
annotations.participant_label: Not harmful — policy concern, cultural commentary, or frustration with no hateful subtext
annotations.rationale:
I'm not really a religious person but am highly spiritual - I feel that we are all connected in some way. I often feel for others and am always wanting to help others where I can, as much as I can.  What shaped my judgment was seeing how everyone needs help and it shouldn't be choosing a side over another but rather, finding opportunities to help others out whenever possible.

If everyone can drop aside all religions and think of the good for all, we would be living in a much more peaceful society. I highly value speaking good words, thinking good thoughts and doing good deeds and it's what I continue to embody in my daily life.
